name: add-camera-camx
description: Vendor CamX camera stack (hardware ISP) for the IMX519 on CSI1, 4-lane with autofocus. Installs the userspace stack plus an integration package that owns the per-SoC layout and diverts the stock socid_map. The DT overlay is staged under /usr/share/tachyon/dtbo for the user to deploy - this overlay never touches /boot/dtb_a. EXPERIMENTAL: delivers HAL3 only, ordinary V4L2 clients are not supported.
